title: Bifrost Helm Chart Values
description: Schema for Bifrost Helm chart values.yaml

tag.description: Image tag (required - validated at template render time)

enabled.description: Create namespaced Role/RoleBinding for Kubernetes pod discovery when cluster discovery type is kubernetes
Create a Prometheus Operator ServiceMonitor for the /metrics endpoint

additionalLabels.description: Extra labels on the ServiceMonitor (match your Prometheus serviceMonitorSelector)

namespace.description: Namespace for the ServiceMonitor; defaults to the release namespace

interval.description: Scrape interval (e.g. 30s); empty uses the Prometheus default

scrapeTimeout.description: Per-scrape timeout (e.g. 10s); empty uses the Prometheus default

tlsConfig.description: TLS settings for the scrape endpoint

basicAuth.description: Authenticate the scrape with Bifrost's admin credentials. Needed when auth is enabled: /metrics sits behind the global auth middleware, so an unauthenticated scrape gets a 401 and the target stays at up=0.

enabled.description: Send HTTP basic auth credentials with each scrape

existingSecret.description: Secret holding the admin credentials; in the Helm release namespace, defaults to the existingSecret from the active governance.authConfig or authConfig. Required explicitly when the ServiceMonitor uses another namespace.

usernameKey.description: Key holding the admin username; defaults to the resolved authConfig's usernameKey, then 'username'

passwordKey.description: Key holding the admin password; defaults to the resolved authConfig's passwordKey, then 'password'

authorization.description: Bearer-token auth for the scrape, as an alternative to basicAuth (mutually exclusive with it). Requires credentials when set.

credentials.description: Secret key holding the credentials. Must be in the ServiceMonitor's namespace.

name.description: Name of the secret holding the credentials

optional.description: Whether the secret or its key must be defined

honorLabels.description: Preserve scraped target labels on collision

ingress.description: Ingress configuration. Either a single ingress (legacy, with top-level 'enabled') or a map of named ingresses (new format, each key becomes a separate Ingress resource named <release>-<key>).

oneOf.description: Named ingresses map. Each key produces a separate Ingress named <release>-<key>. Keys must be valid DNS-1123 label segments (lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens only, no underscores or uppercase) so the resulting Ingress name is a valid Kubernetes resource name.

podDisruptionBudget.description: PodDisruptionBudget for the Bifrost pods. Off by default; when enabled it is rendered only when bifrost.cluster.enabled is true.

enabled.description: Create the PodDisruptionBudget (default false). Takes effect only when cluster mode is enabled.

minAvailable.description: Minimum pods that must stay available during a voluntary disruption, as an integer or a percentage string such as "50%". Ignored when maxUnavailable is set.

maxUnavailable.description: Maximum pods that may be unavailable during a voluntary disruption, as an integer or a percentage string such as "50%". When set, replaces minAvailable.

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Pod topology spread constraints for the Bifrost Deployment or StatefulSet, rendered into the pod spec. A constraint without labelSelector gets the release's server pod selector labels.

maxSkew.description: Maximum allowed difference in matching pods between any two topology domains

topologyKey.description: Node label key that defines a topology domain, e.g. topology.kubernetes.io/zone or kubernetes.io/hostname

whenUnsatisfiable.description: DoNotSchedule keeps a pod pending rather than break the skew; ScheduleAnyway only prefers spreading

labelSelector.description: Pods counted when computing skew. Defaults to this release's server pod selector labels when omitted.

minDomains.description: Minimum number of eligible domains (requires whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule)

matchLabelKeys.description: Pod label keys whose values are added to labelSelector, e.g. pod-template-hash to spread each rollout's pods separately

strategy.description: Deployment update strategy. Applies to the Deployment only (not the StatefulSet). Empty uses the Kubernetes default. Rendered verbatim into spec.strategy.

envLabel.description: Short label (max 10 characters) displayed in the management UI sidebar to identify the environment (e.g. "staging", "prod"). Written into config.json as env_label.

disableOnboarding.description: Hides the management UI setup checklist for every user. Read from config.json on every start and never written to the config store, so it holds on stateless deployments. Written into config.json as disable_onboarding; overrides the BIFROST_DISABLE_ONBOARDING env var.

setupToken.description: Operator-provisioned bootstrap secret required to create the very first admin account when none exists yet. Identical across every node so any node can authorize first-admin creation. Never persisted or logged; also read from the BIFROST_SETUP_TOKEN env var. Supports env.<ENV_VAR_NAME> and vault.<path> references. Renders into config.json setup_token.

schemaUrl.description: Schema location written to config.json $schema and exported as BIFROST_SCHEMA_URL. Leave empty to use the default public URL without injecting the env var. Set for isolated deployments that mirror the Bifrost schema internally. Accepts an HTTP(S) URL, file:// URL, or filesystem path.

sourceOfTruth.description: Controls how config.json is reconciled with the database on startup. "split" (default) preserves existing merge behavior. "config.json" makes explicitly-present sections in the file authoritative — database-only rows for those sections are pruned on startup.

proxyConfig.description: Global outbound proxy (the dashboard's proxy settings page) and which components use it. Renders into config.json's top-level proxy_config.

enabled.description: Turn the proxy on

type.description: Proxy type: http (an http:// or https:// proxy URL) or socks5 (a socks5:// or socks5h:// proxy URL). A bare host:port takes its scheme from the type.

url.description: Proxy URL (supports env.VAR_NAME). Required when enabled.

noProxy.description: Comma-separated hosts that bypass the proxy

skipTlsVerify.description: Skip TLS certificate verification for the proxy

enableForScim.description: Enterprise: route SCIM directory sync and identity-provider requests through the proxy

enableForInference.description: Route inference requests through the proxy

enableForApi.description: Route API requests through the proxy

encryptionKey.description: Encryption key for sensitive data. If not set, encryption is disabled and data is stored in plaintext.

encryptionKeySecret.description: Reference to an existing Kubernetes secret holding the encryption key. Takes precedence over `encryptionKey` when `name` is set.

dropExcessRequests.description: Whether to drop excess requests when pool is full

initialPoolSize.description: Initial size of the connection pool

allowedOrigins.description: CORS allowed origins (supports "*" or URI strings)

disableContentLogging.description: Disable logging of sensitive content (inputs, outputs, embeddings, etc.)

retainContentInObjectStorage.description: When content logging is disabled, offload the full content to object storage as hidden instead of dropping it. Hidden content is never served back through the API/UI — the database row stays metadata-only and is only readable with direct access to the storage bucket. Requires object storage to be configured on the logs store.

allowPerRequestContentStorageOverride.description: Allow individual requests to override content storage via the x-bf-disable-content-logging header or context key, and to opt in to raw-byte persistence in logs via x-bf-store-raw-request-response. When false (default), the global disable_content_logging setting is authoritative and per-request storage overrides are ignored. Does not control sending raw bytes back to callers.

allowPerRequestRawOverride.description: Allow individual requests to send raw provider request/response bytes back to the caller via the x-bf-send-back-raw-request and x-bf-send-back-raw-response headers. When false (default), the provider-level send_back_raw_request/response settings are authoritative and per-request overrides are ignored. Does not affect raw-byte persistence in logs.

disableDbPingsInHealth.description: Disable DB pings in health check

dumpErrorsInConsoleLogs.description: Dump full error details to the server console logs. Useful for debugging; may be noisy in production.

logRetentionDays.description: Number of days to retain logs

maxRequestBodySizeMb.description: Maximum request body size in MB

compat.description: Compat plugin configuration for request type conversion, parameter dropping, and parameter value conversion

convertTextToChat.description: Convert text completion requests to chat for models that only support chat

convertChatToResponses.description: Convert chat completion requests to responses for models that only support responses

shouldDropParams.description: Drop unsupported parameters based on model catalog allowlist

shouldConvertParams.description: Converts model parameter values that are not supported by the model.

azureDeepseek.description: Convert Azure DeepSeek responses requests to chat completions so reasoning is preserved for coding harnesses.

forceReasoningOnlyModelsToResponses.description: Convert chat completion requests to responses for models whose datasheet sets supports_reasoning_with_tool_calls to false, so reasoning is kept instead of being forced off.

convertDecisionToResponses.description: Emulate decision requests through the model's Responses API (a forced function tool) when the provider does not serve the model on a native decisions endpoint. Off by default: without it, such requests fail with unsupported_operation.

prometheusLabels.description: Labels to use for Prometheus metrics

headerFilterConfig.description: Global header filtering configuration for x-bf-eh-* headers forwarded to LLM providers

allowlist.description: If non-empty, only these headers (from x-bf-eh-* prefix) are allowed to be forwarded

denylist.description: Headers to always block from being forwarded

enforceAuthOnInference.description: Require auth (VK, API key, or user token) on inference endpoints

dualCredentialConflictBehavior.description: Behavior when an inference request presents both an IDP access token and a virtual key (x-bf-vk). 'error' rejects with 400; 'prefer_vk' drops the IDP token and uses the VK; 'prefer_idp' (default) uses the IDP token for identity.

extraFieldsPlacement.description: Where inference responses carry Bifrost's extra_fields metadata. 'body' (default) keeps the extra_fields object in the JSON body. 'headers' removes extra_fields from the body (and from every streaming chunk) and sends its scalar fields as x-bifrost-* response headers. In 'headers' mode the large and nested fields are dropped and not sent anywhere: raw_request, raw_response, routing_metadata, guardrail_debug, parse_errors, and on errors key_statuses and billed_usage. Streaming responses only carry the fields known before the first chunk (routing identity, fallback index, cache lookup); per-chunk latency, chunk_index and final totals are dropped.

allowedHeaders.description: Additional allowed headers for CORS and WebSocket

usageEstimationTokenizers.description: Embedded tokenizer vocabularies used to estimate the usage of a cancelled or timed-out stream whose provider never reported it. Empty counts every model with o200k_base or cl100k_base. Each listed family preloads in the background at startup and keeps 4-18 MB in memory; "all" enables every family.

asyncJobResultTTL.description: Default TTL for async job results in seconds (default: 3600 = 1 hour)

requiredHeaders.description: Headers that must be present on every request. Requests missing any of these headers are rejected with 400. Case-insensitive matching.

loggingHeaders.description: Headers to capture in log metadata. Values are extracted from incoming requests and stored in the metadata field of log entries.

whitelistedRoutes.description: Routes that bypass auth middleware. Requests to these exact paths skip authentication checks.

hideDeletedVirtualKeysInFilters.description: When true, deleted virtual keys are omitted from logs filter data.

deleteExpiredVirtualKeys.description: Delete expired virtual keys automatically. A daily cleanup job removes every key whose expiry has passed unless the key sets delete_after_expire to false; keys with delete_after_expire true are removed regardless. Maps to client.delete_expired_virtual_keys.

skipAccessProfileUserVirtualKeyCreation.description: Enterprise only. When true, a user's first access profile never creates a virtual key for them. Maps to client.skip_access_profile_user_virtual_key_creation.

skipAccessProfileUserVirtualKeyDeletion.description: Enterprise only. When true, removing a user's last access profile never deletes their virtual keys; they are kept as ordinary keys. Deleting the user still deletes their keys. Maps to client.skip_access_profile_user_virtual_key_deletion.

entityAccessProfileMode.description: Enterprise only. How team, business unit and customer access profiles combine with a user's own access, using the same values as a project's access rule. 'union' (default) lets each of them add to it; 'intersect' makes each level holding an active profile cap it instead, and ignores the x-bf-customer-id / x-bf-customer-name scope headers. Maps to client.entity_access_profile_mode.

routingChainMaxDepth.description: Maximum depth for routing rule chain evaluation

allowDirectKeys.description: Allow callers to bypass the registered key pool by supplying x-bf-direct-key: true with an Authorization header carrying the provider key. Maps to client.allow_direct_keys.

vkRotationCooldown.description: Cooldown after a virtual key rotation: grace period during which the previous key value still authenticates. Accepts a Go duration string (e.g. "5m", "1h"); integer values are nanoseconds, so prefer strings. 0 or an empty string disables the grace period. Maximum 30 days. Maps to client.vk_rotation_cooldown.

skillsExternalClientUrl.description: Public base URL for Skills Repository marketplaces. Required to enable Claude Code and Codex marketplace serving; skill management and downloads remain available when unset. Supports env var and vault references. Maps to client.skills_external_client_url.

readBufferSize.description: Read buffer size in bytes. This controls the size of the buffer used for reading HTTP headers.

basePath.description: URL path prefix Bifrost is served under behind an ingress or reverse proxy, e.g. "/bifrost". Requests are accepted with or without the prefix. Segments may not be "." or "..", and surrounding whitespace is not allowed. The first segment must not match a Bifrost route (such as api, v1, or openai) or a top-level UI path (such as assets or images). Renders into server.base_path.

bodyBufferPoolLimitBytes.description: Largest request-body buffer (bytes) a keep-alive connection keeps for reuse. Larger buffers are freed after each request; bodies above it are still served. Unset uses the 4 MiB default; 0 means unlimited. Renders into server.body_buffer_pool_limit_bytes.

pluginDownloadPrivateAllowlist.description: Hostnames, IP addresses, or CIDR ranges that custom plugin (.so) downloads are allowed to reach even when they resolve to a private/loopback/link-local/CGNAT address (blocked by default to prevent SSRF). Deploy-time only. Renders into server.plugin_download_private_allowlist.

pricingUrl.description: Custom pricing URL (optional, can be empty)

modelParametersUrl.description: Custom model parameters URL (optional, can be empty)

pricingSyncInterval.description: Pricing sync interval in seconds. Default is 24 hours. Minimum is 3600 seconds (1 hour).

liveModelsSyncInterval.description: How often each provider's list-models response is re-fetched in the background, in seconds. Set to 0 to disable background refresh. Default is 3600 (1 hour); minimum when enabled is 60 seconds.

custom_labels.description: Custom labels to add to all metrics

metrics_enabled.description: Serve the Prometheus /metrics scrape endpoint. Default true.

overhead_breakdown_enabled.description: Export the per-component overhead histogram bifrost_overhead_component_microseconds (overhead latency split by the overhead_component label). Off by default. Requires tracing to be active, since the breakdown is computed from completed trace spans.

user_labels_enabled.description: Add user_id and user_name labels to every bifrost_* metric. Off by default: these are unbounded, so they multiply metric series by end-user count on top of a virtual_key_id label that already reaches tens of thousands of values in large deployments. Prometheus holds every label combination in memory for the retention period and cannot drop a label afterwards.

push_gateway.description: Configuration for pushing metrics to a Prometheus Push Gateway for multi-node cluster deployments

enabled.description: Whether to enable pushing metrics to the Push Gateway

push_gateway_url.description: URL of the Prometheus Push Gateway (e.g., http://pushgateway:9091)

instance_id.description: Instance identifier for grouping metrics. If not set, hostname is used automatically.

push_interval.description: How often to push metrics in seconds

basic_auth.description: Basic authentication credentials for the Push Gateway

required_headers.description: Headers that must be present in requests

ttl.description: Time-to-live for cached responses (supports duration strings like '5m', '1h' or seconds as number, default: 5min)

cache_tool_call_responses.description: Persist responses that carry tool calls. Off by default: a replayed tool call runs in a later caller's agent loop with arguments chosen for someone else's prompt.

disable_identity_scoping.description: Share cache entries across identities. Off by default: an entry is only served to the virtual key and user that wrote it.

default_cache_key.description: Default cache key for semantic cache lookups

config.description: Configuration for the OpenTelemetry plugin. Supports the legacy single-profile shape or the profiles wrapper for multiple collectors.

semaphore_size.description: Cap on how many traces may be injected into this plugin concurrently. A saturated cap causes new traces to be dropped for this plugin only, not process-wide (default: 10000).

inject_timeout.description: Timeout for a single Inject call from the tracer, as a Go duration string (default: 5s). Bounds how long a hung connector can hold a concurrency-budget slot.

service_name.description: Name of the service to report to Datadog. Supports env.VAR_NAME prefix for environment variable substitution (e.g. env.BIFROST_DD_SERVICE)

ml_app.description: ML application name for Datadog LLM Observability grouping (defaults to service_name). Supports env.VAR_NAME prefix for environment variable substitution (e.g. env.BIFROST_DD_ML_APP)

agent_addr.description: Datadog Agent address for APM traces as combined host:port (agent mode only). Supports env.VAR_NAME prefix for environment variable substitution (e.g. env.DD_AGENT_ADDR). Overridden by agent_host when set

agent_host.description: Datadog Agent host for APM traces, set separately from the port (agent mode only). Supports env.VAR_NAME prefix (e.g. env.DD_AGENT_HOST). Takes precedence over agent_addr. Useful in Kubernetes where the host is injected via the downward API (status.hostIP)

agent_port.description: Datadog Agent port for APM traces, used with agent_host (agent mode only). Supports env.VAR_NAME prefix. Defaults to 8126; has no effect when agent_host is unset

dogstatsd_addr.description: DogStatsD server address for metrics as combined host:port (agent mode only). Supports env.VAR_NAME prefix for environment variable substitution (e.g. env.DD_DOGSTATSD_ADDR). Overridden by dogstatsd_host when set

dogstatsd_host.description: DogStatsD server host for metrics, set separately from the port (agent mode only). Supports env.VAR_NAME prefix (e.g. env.DD_DOGSTATSD_HOST). Takes precedence over dogstatsd_addr. Useful in Kubernetes where the host is injected via the downward API (status.hostIP)

dogstatsd_port.description: DogStatsD server port for metrics, used with dogstatsd_host (agent mode only). Supports env.VAR_NAME prefix. Defaults to 8125; has no effect when dogstatsd_host is unset

env.description: Environment tag (e.g. production, staging). Supports env.VAR_NAME prefix for environment variable substitution (e.g. env.BIFROST_DD_ENV)

version.description: Service version tag. Supports env.VAR_NAME prefix for environment variable substitution (e.g. env.BIFROST_DD_VERSION)

custom_tags.description: Custom tags for Datadog metrics and traces. Values support env.VAR_NAME prefix for environment variable substitution

otel_llmobs_conversion.description: Whether Datadog builds its own LLM Observability spans from Bifrost's APM trace. 'disabled' opts the trace out so Datadog does not duplicate the spans Bifrost already sends; 'inherit' leaves the decision to upstream services on the same trace; 'enabled' opts in (default: disabled)

llmobs_gateway_mode.description: Follow Datadog's proxy-service pattern for LLM Observability: open a workflow span per request at the gateway entrypoint so all gateway traffic is queryable as top-level spans. Changes the shape of exported LLM Observability data, so existing dashboards and breakdowns may need updating (default: false)

group_traces_by_session.description: Group requests sharing the same x-bf-session-id header into a single APM trace, with each request as a top-level sibling span. Agent mode only; an inbound W3C traceparent takes precedence (default: false)

disable_content_logging.description: When true, sensitive content (prompts, completions, embeddings) is excluded from traces (default: false)

agentless.description: Use agentless mode to send data directly to Datadog APIs instead of a local agent. Requires api_key (default: false)

api_key.description: Datadog API key, required for agentless mode. Supports env.VAR_NAME prefix for environment variable substitution (e.g. env.DD_API_KEY)

site.description: Datadog site/region for agentless mode (e.g. datadoghq.com, datadoghq.eu)

excluded_attributes.description: Span attribute names to drop before export, matched exactly (e.g. "gen_ai.request.tools"). Unknown names are ignored.

request_headers.description: Request header names to capture as Datadog span tags

metric_dimensions.description: x-bf-dim-* dimension names to forward as DogStatsD metric tags. Off by default; each name multiplies metric series cardinality.

export_overhead_spans.description: Export internal overhead/latency spans (setup, key selection, pipeline phases). Default false.

endpoint.description: HEC base URL, e.g. https://localhost:8088 (required when enabled). Do not include the /services/collector path. Supports env.VAR_NAME prefix

token.description: HEC token, sent as the Authorization: Splunk <token> header (required when enabled). Supports env.VAR_NAME prefix

events_index.description: Splunk event index for per-request events (required when enable_events is true)

metrics_index.description: Splunk metrics index for derived metrics (required when enable_metrics is true)

source.description: HEC source field on every event and metric (default: bifrost)

sourcetype.description: HEC sourcetype for events; metrics use bifrost:metric (default: bifrost:llm)

host.description: HEC host field (defaults to the server hostname)

enable_events.description: Emit one flattened event per request to the event index (default: true)

enable_metrics.description: Derive and emit the metric set to the metrics index (default: true)

disable_content_logging.description: Strip request/response content from events (default: false)

ca_cert.description: PEM-encoded CA certificate to verify the HEC TLS certificate. Supports env.VAR_NAME prefix

insecure_skip_verify.description: Disable TLS certificate verification. Development or isolated environments only; use ca_cert in production (default: false)

custom_fields.description: Static key/value fields added to every event and metric

excluded_attributes.description: Span attribute names to drop before export, matched exactly (e.g. "gen_ai.request.tools"). Unknown names are ignored.

request_headers.description: Request-header name patterns to capture onto events. Use an explicit allowlist of exact header names; wildcards can capture credentials

batch_max_bytes.description: Flush a HEC batch once its concatenated bodies reach this many bytes (default: 524288)

flush_interval_ms.description: Maximum time buffered events wait before a flush, in ms (default: 1000)

post_workers.description: Concurrent HEC poster goroutines, capped at 64 (default: 4)

indexer_ack.description: Enable HEC indexer acknowledgement for confirmed delivery. Set when the HEC token has acknowledgement enabled (default: false)

ack_poll_interval_ms.description: How often to poll Splunk for acknowledgement, in ms (only used when indexer_ack is true, default: 1000)

ack_timeout_ms.description: How long an unacknowledged batch waits before the client resends it, in ms (only used when indexer_ack is true, default: 30000)

max_ack_attempts.description: Maximum POST attempts per batch before it is dropped (only used when indexer_ack is true, default: 3)

excluded_attributes.description: Column names to omit from every row, matched exactly (e.g. "tools"). BigQuery writes typed columns, so these are column names rather than attribute names. trace_id and timestamp cannot be excluded.

export_raw_payloads.description: Store the raw provider request and response bodies. Requires raw request/response storage on the provider and is ignored when content logging is disabled.

topic.description: Kafka topic to publish traces to (required when enabled)

sasl_enabled.description: Enable SASL authentication. SASL is only activated when both sasl_enabled is true and sasl is set

username.description: SASL username. Supports env.VAR_NAME prefix for environment variable substitution

password.description: SASL password. Supports env.VAR_NAME prefix for environment variable substitution

ca_cert.description: PEM-encoded CA certificate used to verify the broker's TLS certificate. Omit to use the system CA pool. Supports env.VAR_NAME prefix

batch_size.description: Maximum number of messages batched per write (default: 100)

flush_interval_ms.description: Maximum time (ms) to wait before flushing a batch (default: 1000)

auto_create_topic.description: Create the topic at startup if it does not exist

disable_content_logging.description: Strip input/output message content from traces before publishing

excluded_attributes.description: Span attribute names to drop before export, matched exactly (e.g. "gen_ai.request.tools"). Unknown names are ignored.

request_headers.description: Request-header name patterns (exact or wildcard like "x-custom-*") whose captured values are embedded in published traces

export_overhead_spans.description: Export internal overhead/latency spans (setup, key selection, pipeline phases). Default false.

topic_id.description: Pub/Sub topic ID — just the ID, not the full resource name (required when enabled)

service_account_key.description: Service account key JSON for authentication. Omit to use Application Default Credentials (ADC). Supports env.VAR_NAME prefix

auto_create_topic.description: Create the topic at startup if it does not exist

disable_content_logging.description: Strip request/response content from traces before publishing

excluded_attributes.description: Span attribute names to drop before export, matched exactly (e.g. "gen_ai.request.tools"). Unknown names are ignored.

request_headers.description: Request-header name patterns (exact or wildcard like "x-custom-*") whose captured values are included in published traces

export_overhead_spans.description: Export internal overhead/latency spans (setup, key selection, pipeline phases). Default false.

placement.description: Plugin execution placement relative to built-in plugins

order.description: Position within placement group. Lower = earlier execution

semaphore_size.description: For plugins that implement ObservabilityPlugin (receive completed traces): cap on how many traces may be injected into this plugin concurrently. A saturated cap causes new traces to be dropped for this plugin only, not process-wide. Ignored by plugins that don't receive traces (default: 10000).

inject_timeout.description: For plugins that implement ObservabilityPlugin: timeout for a single Inject call from the tracer, as a Go duration string (default: 5s). Bounds how long a hung connector can hold a concurrency-budget slot. Ignored by plugins that don't receive traces.

virtual_key_id.description: Associate this budget to a virtual key (mutually exclusive with provider_config_id and team_id)

provider_config_id.description: Associate this budget to a virtual key provider config (mutually exclusive with virtual_key_id and team_id)

model_config_id.description: Associate this budget to a model config (mutually exclusive with the other owner IDs)

customer_id.description: Associate this budget to a customer (mutually exclusive with the other owner IDs)

team_id.description: Associate this budget to a team (mutually exclusive with virtual_key_id and provider_config_id)

calendar_aligned.description: Snap budget reset windows to calendar boundaries

reset_config.description: Window settings the reset duration cannot express. Only valid when reset_duration is quarterly ("1Q").

quarter_start_month.description: First month of Q1 as 1-12 (e.g. 4 = fiscal year starting April). Omitted or 0 means January.

token_last_reset.description: Last time token counter was reset

request_last_reset.description: Last time request counter was reset

access_profile.description: Enterprise: name of the access profile (declared under accessProfiles) this customer holds, in place of budgets and a rate limit of its own. Under source_of_truth split it applies when new or changed and dashboard changes are kept otherwise; under config.json it is enforced on every startup and an entry without it has its profile removed.

Enterprise: name of the access profile (declared under accessProfiles) this team holds, in place of budgets and a rate limit of its own. Under source_of_truth split it applies when new or changed and dashboard changes are kept otherwise; under config.json it is enforced on every startup and an entry without it has its profile removed.

Enterprise: name of the access profile (declared under accessProfiles) this business unit holds, in place of budgets and a rate limit of its own. Under source_of_truth split it applies when new or changed and dashboard changes are kept otherwise; under config.json it is enforced on every startup and an entry without it has its profile removed.

entity_dac.description: Per-entity DAC overrides keyed by resource name. Each entry narrows or widens the role's global dac for that one entity; unlisted entities follow dac. Resources accepting an override as of this chart release: Logs, AuditLogs, VirtualKeys, Users, Teams, Customers, BusinessUnits, RBAC, APIKeys, AccessProfiles, RoutingRules, GuardrailsConfig, Projects. Names are not enumerated here so a resource added by a newer Bifrost works without a chart upgrade; an unrecognised name is logged and skipped at startup. Config is authoritative - the role's whole override set is replaced on each sync, and omitting entity_dac clears it.

access_profiles.description: Names of all access profiles granted by this role. When present, this field takes precedence over access_profile; an empty list removes all profile grants.

expires_at.description: Optional expiry timestamp (RFC3339). Once passed, requests using this virtual key are rejected. Omit for a key that never expires.

delete_after_expire.description: Delete this virtual key automatically once expires_at has passed. Omit to follow client.deleteExpiredVirtualKeys; true or false override it for this key. Requires expires_at.

disable_content_logging.description: Per-key override of client.disableContentLogging for requests made with this virtual key. Omit to inherit the client setting.

metadata.description: Custom key/value metadata for this virtual key (e.g. cost_center, project, owner). Copied onto every log entry the key produces, so logs and spend can be filtered by it, and it overrides request-supplied log metadata on a key collision. Keys may contain letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-' (max 256 characters) and may not be system-reserved; values are strings of at most 512 characters; at most 50 entries.

business_unit_id.description: Associated business unit ID (mutually exclusive with team_id and customer_id)

allow_all_providers.description: Grant this virtual key access to every provider, including ones added later. Coexists with provider_configs: a provider with a config row keeps its model allow/blacklist, budgets, rate limits, and key selection; providers without a config get all models, all keys, and no per-provider limits. When false (default), access is deny-by-default via provider_configs.

allOf.$comment: A virtual key belongs to at most one owner: team_id and customer_id cannot both name one.
A virtual key belongs to at most one owner: team_id and business_unit_id cannot both name one.
A virtual key belongs to at most one owner: customer_id and business_unit_id cannot both name one.

projects.description: Projects declared under governance.projects: what each allows, what it may spend, and how that is divided between its members. Members are added from the dashboard or the API. Renders into governance.projects.

routingRules.description: Routing rules for dynamic provider/model selection based on CEL expressions

fallbacks.description: Fallback chain. Each entry is a 'provider/model' string ('provider/' keeps the incoming model), or an object that additionally pins a provider key. A bare provider name such as 'openai' names no provider and is skipped at request time.

scope.description: Rule scope level. User-scoped rules can be created through the API and UI only: config.json does not support them, and a user-scoped rule is dropped at load with a warning.

scope_id.description: ID (not name) of the team, customer or virtual key. Required for non-global scopes; ignored for global. A new rule whose scope_id does not resolve is dropped at load with a warning; an edit that does not resolve keeps the stored rule, if the stored rule's own scope still resolves, and is dropped otherwise.

priority.description: Evaluation order within the rule's scope (scope plus scope_id); lower runs first. Must be unique within that scope, counting disabled rules and rules created in the UI or API. Two rules in one scope that both omit priority collide, and Bifrost exits at startup. Give every rule that shares a scope its own priority.

semantic.description: Embedding-based (semantic) complexity classification settings. Presence of this block enables the classifier; it embeds the per-tier keyword lists as reference phrases.

provider.description: Provider used to generate embeddings for complexity classification (must have an enabled key)

embedding_model.description: Model used to generate embeddings for complexity classification

timeout.description: Per-request embedding timeout (duration string like '1.5s', or milliseconds as a number; default: 1.5s). On timeout no tier is published for that request.

min_similarity.description: Similarity floor a nearest-phrase match must clear before its tier is used (default: 0, nearest phrase always wins). Compared against the backend's own score scale, so retune when switching vector stores.

fallback.description: What answers when semantic classification produces no tier: none (default), the configured LLM classifier, or the configured decision model.

llm.description: Chat-completion (LLM) classifier settings. prompt.description: Replaces the shipped classification guidance (max 4000 characters); empty means the shipped guidance is used. The gateway always appends a fixed tier-name and response-format reinforcement.

message_history_count.description: How many of the most recent user messages are given to the classifier, oldest first (default: 1, the latest message only).

count_toward_budgets.description: Record classification completion cost against governance budgets (record-only, never enforced; default: false)

tier_boundaries.description: Deprecated lexical-classifier score thresholds. Optional and accepted for upgrades, but ignored by semantic classification.

simple_medium.description: Deprecated and ignored by semantic classification

complex_reasoning.description: Retired REASONING-tier boundary. It is ignored during configuration load because REASONING was merged into COMPLEX; accepted only so older values continue to validate.

keywords.description: Required reference phrases per tier when complexityAnalyzerConfig is non-null. Semantic embeds requests and matches the nearest phrase; the decision model does not read these lists. In split mode the lists merge with stored phrases; the legacy four-list shape remains accepted for upgrades.

description.description: Description of what the rule does

apply_to.description: When to apply the guardrail (input, output, or both)

sampling_rate.description: Percentage of requests to apply this rule to (0-100)

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for rule execution

send_all_conversation_turns.description: Whether to send all input conversation turns to the guardrail provider. When false, max_turns_to_send selects the current input plus preceding turns. Omit this field to preserve legacy behavior.

max_turns_to_send.description: Number of preceding conversation turns to include when send_all_conversation_turns is false. 0 sends only the current input.

evaluation_mode.description: How the rule's turns are sent to its guardrail providers. 'bundled' (default) concatenates all turns into one guardrail call. 'per_turn' sends each turn in its own call, evaluated in isolation, to avoid context-sensitive classifiers (e.g. Bedrock prompt-attack) combining unrelated turns into a false-positive block; this scans every turn but uses more provider calls.

stream_replay_event_interval_ms.description: Delay in milliseconds between consecutive buffered events after block-capable streaming output guardrails allow the response. 0 sends the buffered events immediately.

output_mode.description: What the rule's output phase does with a match. 'enforce' (default) blocks, redacts, or transforms the response before the client receives it, holding a stream when the rule needs the whole response. 'monitor' delivers the response untouched and never pauses the stream; once the response completes it is evaluated in the background and matches are recorded on the request's log (guardrail_debug detections with enforced: false, redacted stored content, and [output-monitor] plugin logs), never enforced. Monitor requires target 'llm' and apply_to 'output' or 'both'; the input phase of a 'both' rule is always enforced.

input_timing.description: When the rule's input check runs. 'pre_call' (default) finishes the check before the request is sent, so it can block, redact, or transform the input. 'parallel' runs the check alongside the LLM call and holds the response until the verdict arrives; only a block is enforced, and redaction findings reach only the logs. Parallel requires target 'llm' and apply_to 'input' or 'both'.

profile_execution_mode.description: How the rule's profiles see the payload. 'independent' (default) gives every profile the original payload. 'chained' runs profiles in provider_config_ids order and gives each one the payload as earlier profiles redacted or transformed it. A rule with one profile never chains.

omitIpAddresses.description: Stop recording client IP addresses in audit logs while keeping every other field. IPs already stored are hidden from the API, filter data, search, exports and archives but not deleted from the database. Default: false

archiveInterval.description: Archival window size and job period, as a Go duration string (e.g. '24h'). The supported range is 5m and above; anything shorter is raised to 5m at runtime rather than failing startup. Only used when objectStorage is set. Default: 24h

archiveGracePeriod.description: How long to hold a window open past its end before archiving it, absorbing clock skew and late inserts. Must be shorter than archiveInterval, otherwise no window would ever close; the runtime substitutes a safe default if it is not. Only used when objectStorage is set. Default: 15m

archiveMaxObjectBytes.description: Roll a new part object once the current part reaches this many uncompressed bytes. Peak node memory is roughly 2x this when compress is true, so size pod memory limits accordingly. The minimum and maximum above are strict validation limits: helm install/template rejects a value outside [1MiB, 4GiB] rather than adjusting it. Only used when objectStorage is set. Default: 134217728 (128MiB)

objectStorage.description: Optional object storage for archiving audit events to S3/GCS/Azure Blob. A background job periodically copies audit events from the database, one closed time window at a time, writing each window as JSONL part objects plus a manifest at {prefix}/audit-logs/YYYY/MM/DD/{start}-{end}/. The database remains the source of truth; archival never deletes rows (retentionDays handles that independently).

default_cooldown.description: How long to keep the circuit open when no header-based cooldown is available. A Go duration string such as '30s', '5m' or '1m30s', or integer nanoseconds. Empty or omitted means 30s.

cooldown_header.description: Response header whose value (in ms) overrides default_cooldown

connMaxIdleTime.description: How long an idle physical connection is kept before being closed (default 5m). Without this the idle cap alone controls pool size, so bursts above maxIdleConns close and reopen connections. The config store and logs store open separate pools.

statementTimeout.description: Server-side statement_timeout set on every runtime pool connection (Go duration string, default 120s). Bounds a runaway query so it cannot hold a pooled connection and its locks indefinitely. "0" or a negative value leaves the server default. Only applies when the store is postgres.

idleInTransactionSessionTimeout.description: Server-side idle_in_transaction_session_timeout set on every runtime pool connection (Go duration string, default 120s). Ends a session left idle inside an open transaction, which would otherwise hold row locks and block vacuum. "0" or a negative value leaves the server default. Only applies when the store is postgres.

migrationLockRetryBudget.description: How long a schema migration step keeps retrying after lock timeouts before the pod exits (Go duration string, default 10m). vaultStore.description: Vault store for external secret management

hiddenRequestTypes.description: Request types hidden from dashboard/API reads. Logs are still stored.

connMaxIdleTime.description: How long an idle physical connection is kept before being closed (default 5m). Without this the idle cap alone controls pool size, so bursts above maxIdleConns close and reopen connections. The config store and logs store open separate pools.

statementTimeout.description: Server-side statement_timeout set on every runtime pool connection (Go duration string, default 120s). Bounds a runaway query so it cannot hold a pooled connection and its locks indefinitely. "0" or a negative value leaves the server default. Only applies when the store is postgres.

idleInTransactionSessionTimeout.description: Server-side idle_in_transaction_session_timeout set on every runtime pool connection (Go duration string, default 120s). Ends a session left idle inside an open transaction, which would otherwise hold row locks and block vacuum. "0" or a negative value leaves the server default. Only applies when the store is postgres.

migrationLockRetryBudget.description: How long a schema migration step keeps retrying after lock timeouts before the pod exits (Go duration string, default 10m). Raise it on large deployments where older replicas' long queries hold the table during a rolling upgrade, and keep startupProbe at least as long. Only applies when the store is postgres.

postgres.description: Point the logs store at a separate external PostgreSQL than the config store (only applies when the logs store resolves to postgres). When enabled:false the postgres logs store shares the top-level postgresql connection.

port.description: PostgreSQL port. Accepts an integer (e.g. 5432) or an env.VAR_NAME string for environment-variable substitution.

passwordCommand.description: Command executed by Bifrost to produce the PostgreSQL password on stdout. The result is cached for cache_ttl and shared across new physical connections

password.description: Must be empty when passwordCommand is set: the password is produced by the command instead.

existingSecret.description: Must be empty when passwordCommand is set: the password is produced by the command instead.

matviewRefreshInterval.description: How often to refresh materialized views. Go duration string (e.g. '30s', '5m', '1h'). Minimum 5s.

matviewRefreshTimeout.description: Maximum time for a single materialized view refresh pass (min 30s, max 30m). Unset derives 5x the refresh interval, at least 5m. A cancelled refresh leaves the existing views intact and readable, just staler; the next tick retries.

matviewRefreshTempFileLimit.description: Caps the temp files each Postgres process running a materialized view statement may write (Postgres temp_file_limit, e.g. '10GB'; parallel workers each get the cap). Unset leaves the server setting alone. Needs superuser or GRANT SET ON PARAMETER temp_file_limit; otherwise skipped with a warning.

migrationMatviewCancelAfter.description: How long schema migrations wait for an in-flight materialized view refresh (from any replica, including older releases mid-rollout) before cancelling its REFRESH statements. Unset uses 60s; 'off' never cancels and only waits.

clickhouse.description: ClickHouse connection settings (only applies when type is clickhouse)

path.description: Directory for file persistence; omit for a memory-only store that re-populates on restart

compress.description: Gzip-compress persisted documents (only used when path is set)

extraContainers.description: Regular sidecar containers appended to the Bifrost pod's containers. Standard Kubernetes container specs.

modelRouter.description: One model router: an id, a name and a description beside the settings of governance.complexityAnalyzerConfig, whose definitions these properties reuse; the model each tier gets; and the routing that decides which requests it takes.

id.description: Stable router id. `defaults` is reserved: it names the endpoint that serves a new router's defaults.

name.description: Display name, unique across routers. Must contain a non-whitespace character.

targets.description: The model each tier gets. A tier with no target keeps the request's model; weights within a tier sum to 1. Omit to keep the targets set in the dashboard; an empty list clears them.

modelRouter.$comment: The same cross-field rules as complexityAnalyzerConfig: session.enabled needs semantic unless the decision model or the llm is primary, semantic.fallback llm needs llm, classifier llm needs llm, and enabled suggestions need semantic as the primary classifier and a model.

complexitySuggestionsConfig.description: Phrase suggestions for the semantic router: a sample of the vectors the semantic classifier computes is kept under each request's log ID so suggestions can cluster real traffic. Request text stays in the logs.

enabled.description: Capture a sample of classified requests for phrase suggestions; default false. Captured requests are kept in Bifrost's vector store, which must be a shared one (Weaviate, Qdrant, Redis or Pinecone): with Chromem, or no vector store, nothing is captured and suggestion runs are refused.

sample_rate.description: Share of classified requests captured; default 0.1.

lookback_days.description: Days of captured traffic suggestions draw on, and how long captured vectors are kept (never longer than the logs); default 7.

schedule.description: When suggestion runs start: at start_at and every interval after it. Default: daily at 03:00 UTC.

every.description: Interval: 1h-23h, 1d-30d or 1w-4w, as a fixed duration. Default 1d.

start_at.description: The first run, an RFC 3339 time such as 2026-11-12T03:00:00Z; runs repeat every interval from it. Default 1970-01-01T03:00:00Z.

max_clustered_requests.description: Most captured requests one run clusters; default 20000.

min_cluster_requests.description: Smallest cluster, in requests, a suggestion is written for; default 6.

provider.description: Provider of the chat model that writes suggested phrases. Set together with model; both omitted take the llm block's model when saved.

model.description: Chat model that writes suggested phrases. Set together with provider; both omitted take the llm block's model when saved.

instructions.description: Replaces the shipped phrase-writing instructions; empty uses them.

tier.description: How each suggestion's tier is decided. Omitted: the llm classifier on the phrase model.

classifier.description: llm: a chat model with the tier prompt, definitions and the router's own phrases as examples. decision: a decision model asked one choice question. Shipped default phrases are never used as examples.

provider.description: Provider of the tier model. Set together with model; both omitted take the phrase model (llm) or the decision model (decision) when saved.

model.description: Tier model. Set together with provider.

prompt.description: llm only: the whole tier prompt (instructions, tier definitions and examples), sent as written followed by the fixed output and safety rules. Empty: generated by each run from the router's tier definitions and its own phrases.

instructions.description: decision only: the choice question's instructions, sent as written. Empty: the shipped instructions.

criteria.description: decision only: each tier's definition, signals and examples, sent as written as that tier's choice. A tier left out is generated from the router (its decision definitions and signals, its own phrases as examples).

modelRouterTarget.description: One model for one tier of a model router. Omitting provider or model keeps the request's value, but a target sets at least one.

provider.description: Target provider name. Omit to keep the request's provider.

model.description: Target model name. Omit to keep the request's model.

key_id.description: Optional provider key ID to pin for this target. Requires provider.

weight.description: Probability weight within the tier (must be > 0). All weights in a tier must sum to 1.

fallbacks.description: Fallback chain used when this target is chosen. A non-empty list replaces the request's chain; omit it or send [] to keep the chain the routing rules set.

modelRouterTarget.$comment: A blank provider or model is no value: the loader trims both and skips a router whose target then sets neither.

modelRouterRouting.description: Which requests a model router takes. Routers are tried after the routing rules, on the request as the routing rules left it: narrowest scope first (virtual key, user, team, customer, then global), by priority within a scope, and the first enabled router whose condition holds classifies the request. Omit to keep the routing set in the dashboard; a router created without it starts off, global, after the other global routers.

enabled.description: Whether the router takes requests.

scope.description: Scope level. User-scoped routing can be set through the API only. Routing whose scope_id does not resolve is skipped at load with a warning.

scope_id.description: ID (not name) of the team, customer or virtual key. Required for non-global scopes; ignored for global.

cel_expression.description: Optional CEL condition over the request as the routing rules left it. Empty takes every request in the scope. A condition of model == "<name>" lets apps ask for the router by that model name. It cannot use complexity_tier: the router decides the tier once it takes the request.

priority.description: Order within the scope; lower is tried first. Unique within the scope among model routers, separate from routing rule priorities.

identity_source.description: Where a federated key gets the OIDC identity token it exchanges. Shared by every provider that supports workload identity federation.

type.description: file: read the token from path on every exchange, so a token the platform rotates on disk is picked up. inline: use token as given

path.description: Absolute path of the identity token, for type file (can use env. prefix). Must be under /var/run/secrets or /run/secrets, or a directory listed in the BIFROST_OIDC_ALLOWED_CREDENTIAL_DIRS environment variable

token.description: The identity token itself, for type inline (can use env. prefix)

datasheetOverride.description: One datasheet entry edit. Both patches are RFC 7386 JSON merge patches: a key sets the value, null clears it, and an omitted key keeps the upstream value.

provider.description: Provider of the datasheet entry, e.g. openai

model.description: Model name as it appears in the datasheet

mode.description: Datasheet mode (chat, responses, embedding, ...). Omit to apply the pricing patch to every mode of the model. Required when is_custom is true.

is_custom.description: Adds an entry the upstream datasheet does not list, e.g. a fine-tuned or self-hosted model

pricing_patch.description: Merge patch over the pricing entry: context_length, max_input_tokens, max_output_tokens, is_deprecated, base_model, architecture and any cost field such as input_cost_per_token

params_patch.description: Merge patch over the model-parameters entry: supports_* capability flags, reasoning_effort_levels, max_output_tokens, supported_endpoints and other model parameters. provider cannot be patched.

sourceLabels.description: Labels whose values are concatenated and matched against regex

separator.description: Separator placed between concatenated source label values

targetLabel.description: Label written by the replace and hashmod actions

regex.description: Regular expression matched against the concatenated source labels

replacement.description: Replacement value written to the target label on a regex match

action.description: Relabeling action, e.g. replace, keep, drop, labelmap, labeldrop, labelkeep, hashmod

url.description: URL of the proxy server (supports env.VAR_NAME or a literal URI)

ca_cert_pem.description: PEM-encoded CA certificate to trust for TLS connections through the proxy (for SSL-intercepting proxies, and for the proxy itself when the URL is https://, supports env.VAR_NAME)

azureStorageSecret.description: A nonempty literal, env.VAR_NAME reference, or structured secret reference

otelEndpoint.description: OpenTelemetry endpoint URL or host:port. Supports env.VAR_NAME prefix for environment variable substitution.

pluginSpanFilter.description: Controls which plugin hook spans this observability connector exports. Omit to export all plugin spans. Mode "include" exports only the listed plugins; mode "exclude" exports everything except them.

otelProfileConfig.description: OpenTelemetry export profile. This legacy single-profile shape is still accepted directly as bifrost.plugins.otel.config.

enabled.description: Whether this profile exports traces and metrics

traces_enabled.description: Enable trace export for this profile. When false, no traces are sent and collector_url is not required, giving a metrics-only profile (pair with metrics_enabled).

service_name.description: Service name to be used for tracing

trace_type.description: Type of trace to use for the OTEL collector

protocol.description: Protocol to use for the OTEL collector

metrics_enabled.description: Enable push-based metrics export via OTLP. Recommended for multi-node cluster deployments.

metrics_endpoint.description: OTLP metrics endpoint URL (e.g., http://otel-collector:4318/v1/metrics for HTTP or otel-collector:4317 for gRPC)

export_timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds for a single trace export. Bounds how long a slow or unreachable collector can hold an export goroutine; gRPC exports have no other timeout.

headers.description: Custom headers sent to both the trace and metrics endpoints (supports env.VAR_NAME prefix)

trace_headers.description: Extra headers sent only to the trace endpoint, overlaid on headers (same key wins). Supports env.VAR_NAME prefix.

metrics_headers.description: Extra headers sent only to the metrics endpoint, overlaid on headers (same key wins). Useful when a collector requires a per-signal header, e.g. a Databricks table name. Supports env.VAR_NAME prefix.

tls_ca_cert.description: Path to TLS CA certificate file

insecure.description: Skip TLS verification (ignored if tls_ca_cert is set)

disable_content_logging.description: When true, message content (input/output messages, embeddings, tool definitions, and tool call arguments/results) is dropped from exported spans. Only metadata such as model, tokens, and latency is sent to the collector.

group_traces_by_session.description: When true, requests sharing the same x-bf-session-id header are grouped into a single OTEL trace, each request's root span appearing as a top-level sibling. An inbound W3C traceparent takes precedence, leaving that request on its own distributed trace.

disable_root_span_content.description: When true, input/output message content is dropped from the root span only; the underlying generation (llm.call) span retains the full content. This removes the duplicate input/output stored at the trace level (e.g. the Langfuse trace Input/Output goes empty) to reduce downstream storage.

apply_trace_dimensions_to_child_spans.description: When true, x-bf-dim-* request dimensions stored on the trace are merged onto child spans as well as the root. Span attributes win on conflict. The suffixes path and method, and keys in reserved attribute namespaces (gen_ai., llm., bifrost., http., url., session., service., k8s., langfuse., openinference., otel.), are skipped. Default false.

excluded_attributes.description: Span attribute names to drop before export, matched exactly (e.g. "gen_ai.request.tools"). Unknown names are ignored.

export_raw_payloads.description: Attach the raw provider request and response bodies to exported spans. Requires raw request/response storage on the provider and is ignored when content logging is disabled.

request_headers.description: Request header name patterns (exact or wildcard like x-custom-*) to capture and emit as span attributes. Note: * captures all headers including sensitive ones like Authorization.

export_overhead_spans.description: Export internal overhead/latency spans (setup, key selection, pipeline phases). Default false.

overhead_breakdown_enabled.description: Export the per-component overhead histogram bifrost_overhead_component_microseconds (overhead latency split by the overhead_component attribute). Off by default. Requires metrics_enabled and an active trace, since the breakdown is computed from completed spans.

otelProfilesConfig.description: OpenTelemetry plugin configuration with one or more export profiles.

prompt_cache.description: Synthesize prompt-cache breakpoints for requests that carry none. Off by default; requests that already carry their own cache markers are never modified.

auto_inject.description: Mark the first cacheable content block, keeping the cached prefix stable across agent turns

ttl.description: Lifetime for injected markers; omit for the provider default

cache_control_injection_points.description: Target specific messages instead. When set, replaces auto_inject rather than adding to it.

index.description: Negative values count from the end

path.description: Path after the route prefix; * matches within one segment, a final /** matches the path and everything below it

does_not_send_done_marker.description: Whether the provider ends streams on finish_reason without sending a data: [DONE] marker

wait_for_usage.description: With does_not_send_done_marker, keep reading past finish_reason so the trailing usage-only chunk is collected instead of dropped. Without it the request records zero tokens and zero cost

models.description: Models this key can access. Use ["*"] to allow all models; empty array denies all (deny-by-default). An entry starting with regex: is an RE2 pattern matched case-insensitively against the whole model name.

weight.description: Routing weight for this key. Optional; defaults to 1 when omitted.
